guitar.guitaristsText: Mick Ronson / Carlos Alomar / Earl Slick
guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul (Ronson) / Fender Stratocaster / Telecaster
guitar.notes: Bowie used many different guitarists across eras with no single signature instrument tied to Bowie himself; medium is appropriate given Ronson's well-known Les Paul.

tone.target: bright glam-rock riff crunch with octave-like edge and light room
tone.profile: bright glam-rock riff crunch with octave-like edge and light room
tone.summary: A tight, biting signal chain using a Boost and OD for attack, followed by the UK 45 amp model to capture the Plexi crunch, finished with Chorus for shimmer and Room reverb.
corrections: push riff attack over lead smoothness
